job.job_description:
Design and develop scalable and efficient AI/ML models and algorithms.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing systems.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Conduct research and experimentation to improve AI/ML model performance.


Work closely with data engineers to design and implement data pipelines.


Deploy and manage AI/ML models in production environments.




Job Requirements




Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering).


Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI API, or Hugging Face.


Strong ML/DL fundamentals (Regression, Classification, NLP, Deep Learning).


Experience building RAG pipelines, AI agents, or multi-agent systems.


Strong Python and SQL skills.


Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS).


Exposure to FastAPI, Docker, AWS (S3, EC2, Bedrock/SageMaker).




Additional Info



The company name is Vrinda International.
